runs.text:
Hola Community! Pablo here, there won't be Blender Today (sick 🤕), but there are THREE new Blender releases TODAY! Including an update to Blender 4.4.

🔶 Blender 4.4.1 → 108 fixes
🔸 Blender 4.2.9 LTS → 15 fixes
🔹 Blender 3.6.22 LTS → 6 fixes

Corrective releases are highly recommended to update, as they only include bug fixes (no new features that could lead to bugs). In particular if you're having issues on macOS Sequoia 15.4, updating is a must. 

See you soon! 
Pablo
